name: Easy Slow Cooker Caldo Verde (Portuguese Green Soup) with Chorizo, Kale, Potatoes & Cornbread

ingredients.name: kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and large dice potatoes. Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place all three in a 6-quart slow cooker insert.

Cut chorizo into bite-sized pieces. Add to the insert along with broth and spices. Stir to combine the soup. Cover and cook until potatoes are tender and flavors have blended, low for 5 hours or high for about 2 hours.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (255 g) pkg chorizo sausage
6 cups chicken or vegetable broth
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the soup is almost done, preheat oven 375°F. Coat 6 muffin cups with cooking spray. Open cornbread tube, separate swirls, and place in muffin cups. Place in preheated oven and bake until cornbread is golden brown, 14-17 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 spritz nonstick cooking spray
1 (312 g) tube cornbread muffin

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, add kale to the slow cooker in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and continue to cook until kale is tender, 15-20 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (283 g) bag kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Divide soup between bowls and serve with cornbread on the side. Enjoy!
